text:
maria: Quick pulse — we have a candidate open model (fenris-lite-3b) queued for the catalog. Need final checks: license clearance, perf profile, and an owners/rollout plan before Friday deploy window.
li: I can finish curation notes today. license looks Apache-2.0 in the repo but I want legal to confirm there are no extra waivers. perf bench queued on small shard.
kevin: pinged legal review queue, should have an answer by EOD. quick Q: any third-party weights or non-standard tokenizers?
li: only the usual tokenizer; weights are from upstream repo (no extra deps). adding manifest excerpt now.
li: ```
model_name: fenris-lite-3b
license: apache-2.0
repo: https://github.com/upstream/fenris-lite
shapes: { context: 2048, vocab: 50272 }
quantization: int8-friendly
```
sara: For the catalog launch checklist: we need perf (p95 < 200ms on ded. 1xA10), embedding sanity, and an owner for canary routing. who will own canary? @tom? :eyes:

maria: @tom can you take canary routing + fallback policy? we want automatic fallback to fenris-base-6b if latency > 250ms or token errors.

tom: I can own routing. Plan: start with 5% traffic to fenris-lite (canary) then 25/50/100 depending on error rate and latency. I'll add a route config today.
kevin: Legal: cleared Apache-2.0 and a short note on upstream CLA. No additional restrictions. I'll add a one-line doc for the catalog entry.
li: Perf: initial microbench looks promising. p50 ~ 95ms, p95 ~ 180ms on a single A10 with current kernels. Need infra to run a 24h stability run (batching + KV cache).
deploy-bot: scheduled bench job fenris-lite-3b-stability at 1732468600 (queued).
maria: Nice. Two blockers then: infra stability run and embedding dimension validation for downstream search (embedding shape should be 1536).
li: I will run embedding sanity tests and attach sample vectors.

tom: Routing config draft: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: fenris-lite-canary
    weight: 5
    fallback: fenris-base-6b
    sloa: latency < 250ms
```

sara: Can product confirm the canary schedule fits the launch window? we prefer canary start Thurs 09:00 PT.
maria: Thurs 09:00 PT is fine for the catalog rollout if the stability run is green by Wed EOD.
kevin: legal will post the short clearance note to the model entry once bench + crawler checks are green.
li: small ask — quant profile: recommend int8 (we verified output fidelity vs fp16 on our eval prompts). putting that in the manifest.
maria: Perfect. Action items: li -> embedding sanity + attach vectors (due 1732468460), tom -> route + canary config (due 1732468520), infra -> run 24h stability bench (deploy-bot already queued), kevin -> final note (pending green).
li: started embedding sanity run now. will post results.

tom: draft route PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/482, PTAL.
kevin: legal note sent to model-entry channel, flagged a tiny CLA comment (already cc'ed li).
maria: thanks all. if no surprises Wed EOD we go green and can push to catalog Thurs. :party-parrot:
li: small follow: does anyone depend on different tokenizer behavior? would like to freeze tokenization test before canary.
maria: no downstream expecting differences; but please add a tokenization diff in the PR so infra/tests can run it automatically.

deploy-bot: bench job fenris-lite-3b-stability started at 1732468200. logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/fenris-lite-3b-stability
ts: all good so far, will update final pass tomorrow.
kevin: marking legal status: cleared -> pending final bench (status flag updated).

maria: OK closing the loop for now — will reconvene async if any blocker pops up. thanks everyone!
